ratings_why.fun: One pile pulled four ways (fight HP, missiles, stats, slots) plus a free board-or-Burrow move every turn gives real ordering puzzles: Snow Hall Guard before Ole, Kits hidden from Ferrywife, Cantor's big unit kept out of the Banner's path.
ratings_why.distinct: The off-board Burrow and spend-rate puzzle are new for Bramble, though the surface is still a familiar token-swarm tribe.

verdict_why: The core works and surprises; two wording fixes (who the front unit is, Raft-builder's target) are needed before it reads cleanly.

points.text: Brother Onward and The Front Lemming never say which unit is the front when F1 is empty, since gaps never close. Define it as your first unit in reading order.
Raft-builder's 'give a unit +2/+2 for each' can be read as one unit getting everything or a different unit per Kit. Say which.
Gerd's flat Bristle 3 ignores the size axis. Bristle equal to Kit size's Attack would tie him to Tunic Weaver and Snow Hall Guard and give the size build its own payoff.
Herding Council is a smaller Ferrywife. Making it fire on the Herd thresholds of 4 that Brood Matron counts would turn the two into a pair you sequence together.
The Tide wins rounds but barely hurts heroes. A late card that lets Onward Kits count as having started the fight would give the Tide a finisher to build towards, not just a downside.

standouts.why: Identical Cousin turns Kits into triple progress or a second Herald or Litter Keeper; the golden one makes a triple from a single copy. Pure Johnny.
Ole makes each Kit either a missile or a body, feeds Cantor at Start of Combat, and rewards seating Snow Hall Guard ahead of him.
Brother Onward's growing Banner plays against Cantor of the Edge (the biggest unit shouldn't be the one dying), so placement really matters.

weakest.why: Tally is solved by free Kits from turn 2. It's a gold card with no decision.
Runway Digger does one small job and adds nothing Front Lemming and Old Mother Lemen don't do better.
Herding Council is a forced small spend that mostly overlaps Ferrywife.

flags.note: Cantor of the Edge with a big Burrow, Old Mother Lemen and Snow Hall Guard could put 100+ stats on one unit per fight, double when golden.
Golden Identical Cousin makes two copies at once, so any single copy of a key unit plus two Kits becomes a triple and a Discover.
Old Mother Lemen plus Gerd and a deep Burrow may stall low-Attack boards into ties.
'Your front unit' isn't defined when F1 is empty.
Unclear whether the +2/+2 per Kit goes to one unit or is split.
